SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message msg JOIN chat_conversation_member m ON m.conversation_id=msg.conversation_id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND msg.sequence>m.last_read_sequence AND msg.sender_id!=#{userId}
